baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predication in 'We made your sleep sabat,' especially the nouns sleep and sabat.
baseline_models.mechanism: State-transformation presents ordinary sleep as an assigned condition whose defining function is repose and cessation of motion.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state makes rest the condition deliberately given to sleep.
Sleep and repose supply the ordinary bodily process being characterized.
Rest, stillness, and cessation of movement supply the process's restorative function.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely identifies sleep as rest.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents human sleep as deliberately configured into a recurring state of restorative stillness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The complement sabatan can activate the cutting branch of س ب ت rather than only its rest branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sleep first stills what was moving, then sabat images that transition as a cut which removes the sleeper from ongoing waking activity.

activation_trace.role: State-transformation supplies the passage from waking motion into another condition.
Stillness after movement supplies the immediate bodily transition into sleep.
Cutting and removal make the stillness a boundary that severs activity.

changed_reading.before: Sleep contains a period of relaxation.
changed_reading.after: Sleep performs a daily severance, removing the person for a time from the continuity of waking action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sleep noun permits the branch of settling toward and trusting something, joined to sabat as rest.
baseline_models.mechanism: Entering sleep entails relinquishing vigilance and settling into a still condition; rest is therefore experienced as an entrusted surrender, not only a mechanical shutdown.

activation_trace.role: Settling toward something and trusting it supplies the sleeper's relinquishment of vigilance.
Rest and stillness supply the condition into which that trustful settling enters.

changed_reading.before: Sleep is an involuntary loss of alertness.
changed_reading.after: Sleep is also a recurring surrender into a made condition stable enough to receive the sleeper.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both sleep and sabat have branches that extend from ordinary repose toward death or a deathlike inert state.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired nouns place nightly sleep on a continuum from repose through complete immobility to death, without yet deciding whether the verse exploits that farther edge.

activation_trace.role: Death and causing death extend sleep toward the outer limit of bodily withdrawal.
The inert state of sleeper, fainted person, or dead person gives that extension a shared posture of motionlessness.

changed_reading.before: Sleep is categorically separate from death.
changed_reading.after: The focus wording permits sleep to be felt as a bounded, death-adjacent bodily withdrawal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prepared bedding, night's covering, and daytime livelihood turn restorative stillness into one station in an engineered daily system: activity is covered and interrupted so life can resume.

activation_trace.role: Sleep and repose provide the recurring bodily phase that the surrounding sequence organizes.
Rest and cessation supply the inactive phase whose place in the cycle is being sharpened.
Preparing and leveling an affair supplies an engineered setting rather than accidental downtime.
Covering with a garment makes night the enclosing phase in which activity can be suspended.
Livelihood and subsistence supply the waking work to which the sleeper returns.

structural_cues: The focus stands between night as garment in 78:10 and day as livelihood in 78:11, within the repeated making sequence of 78:6-13.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preparation, cover, rest, and livelihood in sequence; I infer the enabling arrow from nightly interruption to renewed daytime capacity. A live alternative is that these are parallel provisions without a causal relation.

changed_reading.before: Sleep is a self-contained interval of rest.
changed_reading.after: Sleep-rest is designed infrastructure within the daily alternation, a covered interruption that preserves the possibility of renewed livelihood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence of a blast, human arrival, and resurrection-standing gives the death-adjacent baseline a direction: sleep is not terminal inertia but a small reversible withdrawal whose far analogue is being summoned to rise.

activation_trace.role: Death and causing death supply the mortal edge of the sleep image.
Motionless repose supplies the shared posture linking ordinary sleep to deathlike inertia.
Sending wind into something supplies the initiating blast that ends inert suspension.
Coming and arrival supply the resulting human movement after the blast.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour make renewed standing the large-scale reversal of inertia.

structural_cues: The provision sequence containing sleep precedes the Day of Decision sequence, where the blast is followed immediately by human arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deathlike sleep branches and a blast-arrival-rising sequence; I supply the analogy from nightly sleeping and waking to death and resurrection. The alternative is that the two sequences are evidentiary neighbors without a sleep-waking analogy.

changed_reading.before: Sleep resembles death because both bodies lie inert.
changed_reading.after: Sleep becomes a bounded rehearsal of mortal withdrawal whose defining mercy is reversibility into renewed standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Long confinement and the denial of cooling stillness reverse the focus image: sabat is merciful because it cuts duration and supplies a pause, whereas punishment continues through spans without that release.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and removal supply the interruptive edge that makes a period of rest a break.
Rest and cessation supply the relief produced by that interruption.
Remaining in a place supplies confinement without the focus verse's exit from activity.
Extended spans stretch that confinement against sleep's bounded interval.
Stillness and settling after heat or movement supply a denied analogue to sabat's cooling rest.

structural_cues: Ayat 78:23-25 join prolonged remaining to the explicit absence of bard and drink.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extended confinement and a bard branch of stillness after heat or motion; I infer that punishment lacks the periodic interruption embodied by sabat. Bard may instead contribute only literal coolness, so the rest contrast remains branch-sensitive.

changed_reading.before: Sabat is relief because the sleeper becomes still.
changed_reading.after: Sabat is relief because stillness interrupts duration; the later no-rest sequence reveals the gift to be the break itself, not immobility alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exhaustive enumeration, binding record, and final inspection of what the hands earned preserve continuity across sleep's cut: agency pauses nightly, but its accumulated consequences do not disappear during the pause.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and removal supply the temporary discontinuity in active human doing.
Hiddenness and heedlessness supply the sleeper's temporary loss of awareness.
Counting exhaustively supplies persistence of every item across intervals of awareness.
A binding written determination supplies durable continuity rather than erasure at each cessation.
Directing sight or insight supplies the later recovery of awareness and confrontation.
What the two hands earned identifies the active deeds that remain attributable after suspension.

structural_cues: The exhaustive record in 78:29 is answered at the close by the person seeing in 78:40 what the hands sent ahead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cut into heedlessness, an exhaustive record, and later visual encounter with deeds; I infer that accountability bridges the nightly discontinuity of agency. The alternative is that the accounting sequence has no intended relation to sleep.

changed_reading.after: Sleep suspends action and awareness without suspending the continuity of the acting self or the record that will meet that self on waking and beyond.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah moves from mutual questioning over a reported matter to repeated promised knowing and finally a reality fixed against falsehood; the focus sleep can therefore image an interval of obscured awareness that will end in disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Hiddenness, obscurity, and heedlessness supply the epistemic rather than merely bodily edge of sleep.
Mutual questioning supplies an opening state in which knowledge is socially unsettled.
A report that arrives and is conveyed supplies the object present but not yet assimilated as knowledge.
Disclosure of a thing to the knower supplies the awakening transition out of obscurity.
Establishing and manifesting truth supplies the terminal state in which uncertainty can no longer remain asleep.

structural_cues: The opening question in 78:1 is followed by the doubled 'they will know' in 78:4-5 and the declaration of the true Day in 78:39.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a question-report-knowledge-truth progression and a sleep branch of hidden heedlessness; I map bodily waking onto eventual disclosure. That cross-domain mapping is reader-supplied, and the live alternative confines sleep to bodily provision.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns only the body's nightly rest.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, bodily sleep also models the surah's temporary interval of unknowing before reality becomes disclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sleep's own garment and hiddenness branches enter a surah-wide covering network: night covers protectively, gardens enclose fruitfully, but the final covering blocks truth. Sleep thus becomes a protected enclosure with an epistemic risk if heedlessness is prolonged.

activation_trace.role: A sleeping place or sleep-garment makes sleep itself spatially enveloping.
Hiddenness and heedlessness expose the possible cognitive cost of enclosure.
Covering by clothing gives the immediately adjacent night a protective enveloping function.
Covering and concealment extend enclosure into the fruitful garden image.
Blocking truth turns covering from shelter into culpable concealment at the surah's close.

structural_cues: Night-as-garment immediately follows the focus, while the garden and the final kafir place beneficial and harmful coverings later in the same whole-surah window.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sleep-garment, hiddenness, clothing, garden-cover, and truth-blocking branches; I infer a common covering mechanism with protective and dangerous outcomes. The alternative treats these as unrelated lexical domains, especially the final moral covering.

changed_reading.before: Sleep is a uniformly beneficial retreat.
changed_reading.after: Sleep is a protective enclosure whose temporary concealment restores, while the wider covering network warns against allowing concealment to become enduring heedlessness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the wage-for-work branch of جعل rather than the ordinary verb sense. It remains anchored in the focus verb and sabat-as-rest, and the later matching recompense and gift branches form a coherent allotment mechanism. Downstream prose should mark it as a cross-domain economic analogy, not a lexical replacement for 'made.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb's stipulated-reward branch can recast the made rest as something allotted in return for exertion.

activation_trace.role: A reward stipulated for work supplies the unusual idea that sleep-rest is an allotted return for expenditure.
Rest and cessation identify the concrete allotment received by the sleeper.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the return-for-expenditure structure.
A measure equal to need or counterpart supplies calibration rather than arbitrary reward.
Giving and handing over supply the gratuity side of the allotted rest.

changed_reading.before: Rest is simply built into human biology.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each sleep is an allotted countergift, a measured return that answers the expenditure of waking life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a gait branch of س ب ت reverses the dominant stillness image. It remains directly anchored in sabatan, while the later movement and return branches allow a coherent distinction between an unmoving body and temporal passage. Downstream prose should call it a branch-distant analogy and should not translate sabat as travel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The particular-gait branch of the focus word sabatan permits a paradoxical movement reading inside bodily stillness.

activation_trace.role: A particular gait supplies the paradox that sabat can image passage as well as cessation.
Ordinary sleep keeps the proposal attached to the body's visibly resting state.
Motion and flowing supply a whole-surah image of apparently fixed things entering passage.
Return to a destination supplies the endpoint that makes sleep's temporal passage bounded.

changed_reading.after: At the exploratory branch level, the still sleeper is carried through a bounded temporal passage toward return.

strongest_changes: The daily provision sequence turns sleep-rest into designed infrastructure between protective night and active livelihood.
The blast, arrival, and rising sequence revises deathlike inertia into reversible withdrawal, while prolonged confinement without cooling stillness defines the contrasting absence of a break.
The exhaustive record and final inspection make sleep a suspension of action and awareness that does not suspend personal continuity or accountability.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet allowed the immediate night-day mechanism and the remote rising, confinement, accounting, and covering reversals to remain active together instead of collapsing sleep into a single gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The sleep-to-resurrection relation is a reader-supplied analogy even though both ends are strongly branch-anchored.
The contrast with denied bard depends on carrying its stillness-after-heat branch alongside its ordinary cooling sense.
The epistemic and covering models may be coherent whole-surah resonances rather than intended functions of the focus construction.
The recompense and temporal-passage outliers should remain explicitly exploratory because their focus branches are form-distant.
